expedition.frontierhunts.ui.campaign.par: Party members within 96 m share hunt events toward their own current objective. Biome visits, tranquilizer surveys and trophy placement stay personal. Invite with /expedition invite <name> (Lodge page).
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.contract.exp: Abandon it or take another contract; no campaign progress is lost.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.contract.rea: Earned before the deadline — collect whenever you like.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.contract.rul: One contract at a time. Each runs for 20 minutes; payment earned in time stays available after the clock runs out. Contract hunts are shared with party members nearby.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.how.clue: Aim at tracks, blood or sign and press Use to inspect it, or right-click a natural rub or scrape.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.how.craft: Counts any Frontier Hunts item you craft, at a crafting table or the weapons workbench.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.how.display: Place a recovered trophy on a trophy plinth.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.how.fish: Land a living fish with the float rod or the bowfishing bow.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.how.group: Field-dress a whitetail while a party member is within 96 metres.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.how.harvest: Counts when you finish field-dressing a whitetail with the Contour Skinning Knife.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.how.harvest_: Counts when you finish field-dressing the animal.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.how.longshot: Field-dress a whitetail you shot from 75 metres or more.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.how.survey: Hit a whitetail with a tranquilizer dart. Each deer can be surveyed once.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.how.visit: Counts each new biome you stand in. Keep moving through different country.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.how.vital: Counts when you field-dress a whitetail that was hit in the heart or lungs.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.ledger.empty: Your first report appears here once it is filed.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.ledger.title: Mara's expedition ledger
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.lodge.in_par: You are in a hunting party. Members within 96 m share hunt progress (up to 8 hunters).
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.lodge.next: Next upgrade: %s (%s tokens). Upgrades issue storage, then the ammo reloader, bow tuning rack and fishing station.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.lodge.no_mar: No marker shared yet. Sharing marks where you stand for everyone in your party.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.lodge.no_par: Invite a hunter with /expedition invite <name>; they accept here. Members within 96 m share hunt progress (up to 8).
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.lodge.no_rec: No hunters on the board yet.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.next.board: Take a contract from the board
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.next.board_d: The campaign is filed. Contracts pay tokens and can be repeated with friends.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.next.contrac: %s tokens are waiting. Payment earned in time stays available.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.next.label: NEXT
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.next.report_: Objective complete. File it for %s tokens.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.next.starter: Guide, field bow and arrows, knives, float rod and an expedition board. The survey only starts once you have them.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.next.waiting: Waiting for the reserve's field records…
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.seasons.no_b: Stand within 6 blocks of an expedition board to buy tags.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.seasons.seas: %s · %s%% through the season · %s day(s) left this month
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.seasons.tags: Optional permit: 8 tokens buys 3 recovery tags for one species this month, only while it is in season. Each animal of that species you field-dress files a tag and pays 5 tokens. Ordinary hunting and the campaign never need tags.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.stores.bench: Ammunition packs hold twelve rounds. Weapons workbench: firearms and blades. Ammo reloader: cartridges and shells. Bow rack: bows and arrows. Fishing station: rods and tackle. Attachment bench: optics and parts (select the weapon in the hotbar, pick a part, Install; Remove returns it).
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.stores.gear_: Hold a field pack or quiver and press Shift + your Pack key for Field Gear: both worn slots work together and a worn quiver feeds arrows.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.stores.no_st: Stand within 6 blocks of an expedition station to buy.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.stores.stati: At an expedition station — purchases use your tokens.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.training.bow: Each rank: fish tire faster on the line.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.training.int: Earn a point per 100 expedition XP (filed reports +60, contracts +40, recoveries +15). Spend it by finishing a field challenge within 15 minutes; each challenge ranks up to 3. One challenge at a time.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.training.mar: Challenge: two heart/lung recoveries shot from 12 m or more.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.training.sur: Each rank: slow healing while fed near an expedition station.
Challenge: craft three Frontier Hunts items.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.training.tra: Each rank: +0.6 blocks clue inspection range.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.waiting: Waiting for the reserve's field records…
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.why.board: Stand within 6 blocks of an expedition board.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.why.busy: Finish, collect or abandon your current contract first.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.why.has_tags: You still have tags this month.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.why.no_party: You are not in a party.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.why.no_point: No points to spend — earn 100 expedition XP.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.why.not_read: Complete the objective before the timer runs out.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.why.station: Stand within 6 blocks of an expedition station.
